title: Horizontal coefficient-component naturality
statement:
theorem trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent_horizontal
    (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) (U : S.ProEt) :
    (trfAutomorphismRawRing l E g).obj.map
        (Prod.mkHom (homOfLE h) (𝟙 U)).op ≫
      trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent l E g (op (n, U)) =
    trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent l E g (op (m, U)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E S).obj.map
        (Prod.mkHom (homOfLE h) (𝟙 U)).op

source.place: Tags 03CZ and 09A5; vertical and horizontal factorization of sequence-site arrows.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the existing coefficientDiagramMap to the arbitrary order arrow. Identify its components with the finite inverse-image coefficient maps. The generic map_opSequence identity identifies forgetting commutativity in the commutative coefficient sequence with the recorded ring coefficient sequence. The generic horizontal_map calculation then identifies both sequence-site horizontal restrictions with these component maps; faithfulness of the commutative-ring forgetful functor lifts the equality.
